description: Draft a payment reminder email for one unpaid invoice in a friendly, firm or final-notice tone. Returns a subject, plain-text body, days overdue and a suggested next step. Use late_fee_calc first if you want the fee amount quoted in the email. Draft only: nothing is sent. Pure calculation: no network request, nothing is sent or stored. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input returns an error and is not charged.

as_of.description: Today's date for the days-overdue count, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC)

final_deadline_days.description: Final notice: days the client has to pay

from_name.description: Your name or business, used in the sign-off

late_fee_terms.description: Your agreed late-fee terms, e.g. "1.5% per month"; mentioned in the final notice only

name: payment_reminder_draft
